title: Reschedule handoff triggers an internal receptionist SMS alert after task creation
description: The caller wants to reschedule an existing visit and provides complete synthetic identity data in the first turn. For latency, the assistant may create the reception task immediately on that first turn instead of inserting a separate phone-confirmation turn. When the internal SMS tool is available, it should call sendSmsToReceptionists only after createReceptionTask succeeds and should reuse the created taskId.

assertions.description: The assistant should not try to create a booking directly for a reschedule request.
assertions.root_cause_hint: assistant left the handoff branch and tried to schedule directly

assertions.description: The assistant should not try direct scheduling for a reschedule request.
assertions.root_cause_hint: assistant ignored the reschedule handoff policy and tried scheduling anyway

rubric.description: With complete identity data in the first turn, the assistant should create the reception task immediately.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant added an avoidable confirmation turn instead of using the clear first-turn identity data

rubric.description: If the caller already gave the name and number in the first turn, the assistant should not ask for the name again.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant restarted the reschedule branch and asked for identity again instead of confirming the spoken phone number

rubric.description: The reschedule handoff should repeat the phone number using spoken words, not raw numerals.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant still repeats the handoff callback number as digits

rubric.description: The reschedule branch should create a reception task after confirmation.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant confirmation flow or createReceptionTask workflow failed before the internal SMS step

rubric.description: The handoff should keep the reschedule_or_cancel task type.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant mapped the reschedule request to the wrong task type

rubric.description: The handoff payload must not include a free-text summary field.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant is still sending free-text summary data in createReceptionTask

rubric.description: The handoff payload must not include a free-text notes field.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant is still sending free-text notes in createReceptionTask

rubric.description: The internal receptionist SMS should be triggered on the same first turn once the handoff task succeeds.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant did not call sendSmsToReceptionists after the handoff task succeeded

rubric.description: The internal receptionist SMS should be triggered only after createReceptionTask has already returned its result.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant called sendSmsToReceptionists before createReceptionTask returned the taskId

rubric.description: The internal SMS workflow itself should accept the receptionist alert request.
rubric.root_cause_hint: sendSmsToReceptionists was called but the SMS workflow rejected or failed the request

rubric.description: The internal receptionist SMS must reuse the exact taskId returned by createReceptionTask.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant did not propagate the created taskId into sendSmsToReceptionists

rubric.description: The internal SMS workflow should target exactly one configured receptionist recipient in this staging flow.
rubric.root_cause_hint: sendSmsToReceptionists produced an unexpected recipient count in the workflow result

rubric.description: The internal SMS workflow should return the receptionist follow-up notification payload.
rubric.root_cause_hint: sendSmsToReceptionists did not return the expected receptionist notification payload

rubric.description: The internal receptionist SMS payload should keep the reschedule_or_cancel task type.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant lost the handoff task type before the sendSmsToReceptionists call

rubric.description: A reschedule handoff with internal SMS must not create a new booking.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant attempted to createEvent instead of staying in the handoff branch
